verdict.rationale: Tailscale's KB documents subnet routers as a first-party feature that lets devices outside a local network reach services within specific subnets, extending the private network. That matches the story's core. The evidence is only short KB summaries, with no setup or routing detail and no community or hands-on report specifically about subnet routing. Missing for 10: in-depth subnet router configuration documentation (route advertisement, approval, ACL scoping), independent or hands-on corroboration of subnet routing working in practice.
